title: Trade Desk earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
summary: Investing.com -- Trade Desk Inc (TTD) beat Q3 estimates, yet revenue was still flat year over year. The stock rose 15.47% to $14.93 in regular trading on Nov 9, 2026, per Investing.com. It was at $15.31 (+2.57%) at 12:31 PM EST on Nov 10, 2026. That is still down about 65% over one year.

title: Affirm Printed a “No-Apologies Quarter” and Still Lost 16% in a Month. BMO Sees 53% Upside
summary: Key TakeawaysAffirm shares fell 16% in the past month as a hot inflation report, a post-midterm sell-off and credit warnings from Upstart and Block hit consumer lenders. Affirm’s fiscal first quarter beat its own guidance on volume, revenue and revenue less transaction costs, and it raised its full-year GMV outlook to more than $65.
